name: Death
intro: The Death pathway commands spirits, corpses and the boundary between life and death. It combines necromantic power with relentless attrition and survival tools.

meter.name: Soul
meter.gain: Final enemy deaths and spirit contact
meter.full: Restore or sustain your one temporary undead companion
meter.quirkText: Combat-only death, revival and undead control.

ability.name: Cold Body
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Cold Body — +10% Max HP; +10% Corrosion direct-damage resistance, +10% Frost direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Undying Touch
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Undying Touch — Deals 160% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −15% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 13 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Necromancy Summon
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Necromancy Summon — Deploy one prepared, kill-acquired spirit vessel for 4 turns, with 100% of the owner's ATK and INT. At 100 charge, sustain the companion.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 20 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Spirit Body Door
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Spirit Body Door — Deals 160% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Freeze (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Zombie Transformation
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Zombie Transformation — Deals 230% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); +25% DEF for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Undying Rebirth Aura
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Undying Rebirth Aura — Targets all enemies; Deals 150% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); Grants a 25% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Underworld Domain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Underworld Domain — Enemy DEF −20% for 2 turns; Enemy SPEED −20% for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 55 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.label: Active
ability.description: Pale Emperor Gaze — Deals 310% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Freeze (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Death's Herald
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Death's Herald — Deals 360% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Death damage (22% base DEF bypass); Executes targets already below 15% Max HP; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Eternal Death
ability.label: Active Authority
